# Bell24h — AI-Powered B2B Procurement Platform

## About
Bell24h is India's AI-powered B2B marketplace connecting buyers and suppliers across 450+ categories.
Built by Digitex Studio, Thane, Maharashtra, India.
Website: https://www.bell24h.com

## Key Features
- Voice RFQ: Record procurement requests via microphone (Groq Whisper transcription)
- Video RFQ: Submit video-based RFQs with AI analysis
- Text RFQ: Traditional text-based Request for Quotation
- AI Supplier Matching: NVIDIA-powered matching across 450+ categories
- Escrow Payments: Secure buyer-held escrow via Bell24h Wallet
- Trust Scores: Algorithmic 0–100 trust rating for all suppliers
- GST Auto-fill: Automatic GST number validation and business details fetch
- HSN Code Lookup: AI-powered HSN/SAC code suggestions

## Categories (50 parent categories)
Agriculture, Apparel & Fashion, Automobile, Building & Construction,
Chemicals, Computer Hardware & Software, Electrical & Electronics,
Food & Beverages, Furniture & Decor, Healthcare & Pharma,
Industrial Machinery, Jewellery, Leather Products, Lighting,
Metals & Alloys, Mining & Minerals, Office Supplies, Packaging,
Paper & Printing, Plastics & Polymers, Rubber Products,
Safety & Security, Sports & Fitness, Textiles, Tools & Hardware,
Toys & Games, Transport & Logistics, Wood & Timber, and more.

## How It Works
1. Buyer posts an RFQ (voice, video, or text)
2. AI matches with verified suppliers in the category
3. Suppliers submit competitive quotes
4. Buyer accepts best quote — deal is created
5. Escrow locks payment until delivery confirmed
6. Payment released to supplier on confirmation

## Pricing Plans
- Free (Starter): 2 RFQs/month, basic features
- Pro: Unlimited RFQs, priority matching, AI features
- Enterprise: Custom, dedicated support, API access
